Earlier orientation soft-surface and binary-allocation values are different representations, and their stored source hashes do not match the current tree; do not substitute them for Session-5 E2.
Session-5 E2 and its matched controls share the recorded folds/evaluator and have paired physical-cluster confidence intervals; that within-session result does not make historical H57-K comparable.
The current training_features.tif and feature-array cache are absent, so no Session-5 geophysical run was reproduced during this follow-up.
benchmark_conclusion: The H57-K geophysics result cannot be ranked against Session-5 E2 because its canaries, split, and provenance are deficient. Session-5 E2 is a positive paired HOLDOUT-DTI result versus its matched controls on the recorded spatial holdout (evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, 11,321 withheld positives, 95% CI as stored), but it was not rerun in this follow-up and is not an ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED score or a live/private prediction. Session-6 full-registry evidence still fails the literal uniqueness gate; no candidate is promoted or authorized for download/submission.
